zh.decision_text: 【准备南征】清军刚入关，大部分兵力仍用于平定北方。摄政王多尔衮命豪格镇守北京，阿济格和多铎分别率军平定山陕和河南。待北方稳固后，再调主力南下。暂时不可轻动。

en.decision_text: 【Prepare Southern Campaign】The Qing have just entered the pass. Most forces are still pacifying the north. Regent Dorgon orders Haoge to hold Beijing while Ajige and Dodo subdue Shanxi-Shaanxi and Henan respectively. Conserve strength until the north is secure.

zh.decision_text: 【休整部队】大顺军自北京败退后损失惨重。李自成命各部在四川盆地休整，补充粮草兵员。同时派出细作打探清军和南明动向，待机而动。不可轻易出击。

en.decision_text: 【Regroup Forces】The Shun Army is battered after their retreat from Beijing. Li Zicheng orders all units to regroup in the Sichuan basin — replenish food and recruits. Dispatch scouts to observe Qing and Ming movements. Do not engage recklessly.

zh.decision_text: 【观望时局】郑芝龙坐镇福建，拥有东亚最强大的水师。北方战火未波及闽粤，正是发展贸易、积累财富的时机。同时向南明派遣使节试探合作条件，不宜过早选边。

en.decision_text: 【Watch the Situation】Zheng Zhilong commands East Asia's strongest fleet from Fujian. The northern war has not reached Fujian or Guangdong — a perfect time to expand trade and accumulate wealth. Meanwhile, send envoys to probe Southern Ming's cooperation terms. No need to pick sides yet.

zh.decision_text: 【定策南京】弘光帝在南京即位，史可法督师江北，马士英主政朝堂。当务之急是稳住江南半壁，调集江北四镇兵力沿淮河布防，确保漕运畅通。同时遣使赴福建催促郑芝龙出兵勤王，并派员安抚左良玉，以防其拥兵自重。南明虽偏安，然江南赋税之区尚在，若能整军经武，未必不可抗衡北朝。

en.decision_text: 【Secure Nanjing】The Hongguang Emperor has ascended in Nanjing — Shi Kefa commands the northern front while Ma Shiying controls the court. The immediate task is to stabilize the southern half of the realm: deploy the Four Garrisons along the Huai River, secure the Grand Canal grain shipments, and dispatch envoys to Fujian urging Zheng Zhilong to send reinforcements. Meanwhile, placate General Zuo Liangyu lest he grow too independent. Though the Southern Ming holds only half the empire, the wealthy Jiangnan tax base remains intact — with proper preparation, it may yet hold against the invaders.
